mapper.sql: select e.id, e.tenant_id as tenantId, e.company_id as companyId, c.company_name as companyName, e.station_id as stationId, s.station_name as stationName, e.device_id as deviceId, d.device_name as deviceName, e.alarm_code as alarmCode, e.alarm_name as alarmName, e.severity, e.alarm_status as alarmStatus, e.occurrence_count as occurrenceCount, e.first_time as firstTime, e.last_time as lastTime, e.clear_time as clearTime, e.clear_type as clearType, e.clear_by as clearBy, e.ack_time as ackTime, e.ack_by as ackBy, e.source_type as sourceType, e.source_payload as sourcePayload, coalesce(e.last_time, e.first_time) as time, coalesce(e.alarm_name, e.alarm_code) as message from ems_alarm_event e left join ems_company c on c.id = e.company_id and c.del_flag = '0' left join ems_station s on s.id = e.station_id and s.del_flag = '0' left join ems_device d on d.id = e.device_id and d.del_flag = '0' where 1 = 1

when.test: (scope.companyIds != null and scope.companyIds.size() > 0) or (scope.stationIds != null and scope.stationIds.size() > 0)

mapper.select: and e.alarm_status = 'ACTIVE' order by coalesce(e.last_time, e.first_time) desc
mapper.update: update ems_alarm_event set alarm_status = 'ACKED', ack_time = now(), ack_by = #{ackBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and alarm_status = 'ACTIVE'

update ems_alarm_event set alarm_status = 'CLEARED', clear_time = now(), clear_type = #{clearType}, clear_by = #{clearBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and alarm_status in ('ACTIVE', 'ACKED')
mapper.select: select distinct tenant_id from ems_alarm_event where alarm_status in ('ACKED', 'CLEARED')
